sections.title: Private Lessons for University and Secondary School Students
paragraphs: I offer private lessons tailored to students' individual needs, covering a wide range of subjects and topics.

list.label: University exam preparation
list.text: personalized support in Mathematics to help students be effectively prepared for exams, clarifying complex topics, and strengthening problem-solving skills.

list.label: Secondary school tutoring
list.text: focused lessons for the upper secondary school students, aimed at building a solid foundation in Mathematics and Physics through clear explanations and practical exercises.

list.label: Remedial exam assistance
list.text: specialized help for upper secondary school students with suspended judgment in Mathematics and Physics, offering targeted reviews and practice tests to ensure success.

list.label: Introduction to LaTeX
list.text: a beginner-friendly introduction to the LaTeX typesetting language, ideal for students who wish to produce professional-quality academic documents or theses.

after: Lessons are flexible and adapted to each student's learning style. For more information or to schedule a session, feel free to contact me!

sections.title: Terms and Conditions
paragraphs: Lessons can be conveniently booked by contacting me. I will be happy to work with you to find the solution that best suits your teaching and organizational needs. See below for my contact details.
I offer maximum flexibility regarding lesson formats:

list.label: Distance learning
list.text: (via digital platforms with virtual whiteboard support and screen sharing)

after: To ensure an organized and efficient service for all students, please notify any cancellations at least 24 hours in advance. Timely cancellations allow for easy rescheduling. **Missed lessons without prior notice may incur a fee.**
